item.text:
For a partial-year HVAC unavailability period of **n days**, ResStock randomly selects a start date within the applicable **Building America heating or cooling months**. It uses the **`building_id` as the random seed**, making the selection reproducible. The period can extend beyond the season.

Where no Building America months are defined for the relevant season, it assumes:

- **Heating:** December through February.
- **Cooling:** June through August.

Source: [ResStock 2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide, §8.4.7, p. 153](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=153).
